artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Calendar of Saints"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with angels and a procession under an archway. The illustration portrays a celestial environment with clouds, angelic figures, and musical celebrants with trumpets. There is a central figure surrounded by others under a monumental arch. Below the scene is a cartouche with a Latin and French inscription. The drawing features intricate detailing and hatching to add texture to the composition.

artworks.title: Circumcision; Festival of Name of Christ; St. Odilo; St. Euphrosyna
artworks.description: The image is a print divided into four sections, each depicting a different religious scene related to Christian themes. In the top left section, several figures stand around an altar with a central child figure on a table. The architecture includes columns and an arched ceiling. In the top right section, a winged angel and a person in religious robes kneel facing each other, with rays of light and a divine symbol above them under a cloudy sky. The bottom left section shows two male figures in robes, with one gesturing and another person standing slightly to the back, in front of a classical architectural setting. The bottom right section portrays three figures in long robes, two of whom appear to be engaged in conversation, standing in front of a building complex with trees and mountains in the background. The print's background remains minimal, emphasizing the figures and scenes depicted.

artworks.title: St. Genevieve; St. Titus; St. Simeon Stylites; Epiphany
artworks.description: This drawing features four religious scenes in circular frames on a single sheet. The scenes are laid out in a grid pattern. The top left scene shows a robed figure with a pastoral staff, an angelic entity to the left, and a landscape in the background. The top right scene features a figure in a bishop's mitre gesturing from a pulpit-like structure to a gathered crowd in what seems to be a church. The bottom left scene depicts a nativity-like scene with a mother and child surrounded by figures. The bottom right scene shows a figure standing on a pillar with onlookers pointing upwards, set against a backdrop of buildings under a serene sky.

artworks.title: Return from Egypt; St. Apollinaire; St. Julian and Basilissa; St. Paul the Hermit
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features four oval illustrations, each centered in a rectangular frame. In the top left illustration, there are three figures walking together. The top right illustration shows a single standing figure. The bottom left illustration depicts two figures, and the bottom right illustration shows a seated figure in a cave-like setting. Each illustration includes figures in classical religious attire and settings with minimal backgrounds.

artworks.title: St. Theodosius; St. Tatiana; St. Hilary; St. Felix
artworks.description:
This is an image depicting four religious scenes, each labeled with a saint's name and a date in January. The image comprises four individual panels showing different saints and scenes. 

The upper left panel shows a standing figure with a halo and a kneeling figure outdoors with sparse vegetation and a distant building, labeled "S. THEODOSIUS ABB."

The upper right panel features a figure with a halo kneeling before two animals outside the walls of a city or fortress, labeled "S. TATIANA V. ET M."

The lower left panel shows a robed figure with a staff standing beside a body of water with landscapes in the background, labeled "S. HILAR EPI ET CO."

The lower right panel depicts a sleeping or reclining figure beneath a cloud beside a standing guard with symbols suggesting divinely inspired elements, labeled "S. FOELIX PRES ET M."

artworks.title: St. Maurus; St. John Calybite; St. Marcellus; St. Honoratus
artworks.description: Four oval illustrations arranged in a grid pattern are captioned with dates and titles. The top-left illustration shows a man in religious attire holding a crozier, with animals and a small building in the background. In the top-right illustration, two men are inside a structure, with one lying on a bed and the other leaning over. The bottom-left illustration shows a kneeling man next to a papal crown, with horses and a stone wall in the background. The bottom-right illustration depicts two men standing, one holding a crozier, sharing an object, with open land and a building in the distance. The illustrations have a monochromatic, etched style with detailed line work.

artworks.title: St. Anthony; St. Prisca; St. Germanicus; Sts. Fabian and Sebastian
artworks.description: The image consists of four illustrations within circular frames. The top left illustration shows a standing person in a dress with a halo above their head, curly hair, and a serene expression, holding a palm leaf and accompanied by a lion. The top right image portrays a hooded figure with a long beard, reading from a book or scroll, and holding a staff, with a cityscape and hills in the background. The bottom left illustration shows two figures: a man in a mitre holding a palm leaf and a younger man also holding a palm leaf, with additional figures in the background. The bottom right scene features a person engaged with a lion near a tall structure, wearing a flowing garment with wavy hair. Surrounding each frame, there is blank space for inscriptions or captions.

artworks.title: St. Agnes; The Marriage of the Virgin; St. Ildefonsus; St. Timothy
artworks.description: The image shows four oval panels each depicting a religious scene. The top-left panel shows a robed figure with a lamb, the top-right panel shows a ritual with several figures, the bottom-left panel shows a interaction between two figures, and the bottom-right panel shows a figure holding a palm branch. Each scene is framed within ornate oval borders on a blank background.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saul; St. Paul; St. John Chrysostom; St. Cyril of Alexandria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four separate scenes arranged in panels. The top-left panel depicts figures and horses in an outdoor setting. The top-right panel shows an individual in a long robe, holding a staff and wearing a broad-brimmed hat. In the bottom-left panel, a group of figures is in front of a building. The bottom-right panel shows a figure in religious attire gesturing towards the sky, with another smaller figure nearby. The illustration is detailed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: St. Sulpicius; St. Aldegondes; St. Sabina; The Calling of St. Mark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four oval illustrations depicting various scenes labeled with specific dates in January. The full-description of the image shows four separate scenes, each confined within its own oval shape. The first illustration appears to depict a religious or historical figure in a bed, surrounded by three people in robes, one of whom holds a staff. The second drawing features an angelic or holy figure arching a tree, with a backdrop of structures suggesting a quiet rural or monastic setting. The image in the bottom left contains a seated female figure beneath a grand architectural arch, with architectural elements like columns extending into the background. Lastly, the bottom right scene portrays a group of robed figures holding banners or canopies, participating in what seems to be a ceremonial procession, with domed buildings and towers in the background. Each illustration presents historical or religious attire and settings in a similar art style, suggesting they are part of a themed or serialized work.

artworks.title: St. Ignatius; Purification of the Virgin; St. Blaise; St. Isidore
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes. The drawing consists of four distinct oval frames placed in a grid, each depicting a different religious scene with a central haloed figure engaged in an activity. In the top left, a figure is kneeling in front of a lion, suggested by the text 'S. IGNATI.' The top right scene shows a veiled figure presenting a child to another figure on steps, indicated by 'PVRIFICATIO' and 'B. MARIAE V.' The bottom left drawing depicts a figure kneeling to bless livestock within rural surroundings, with the text 'S. BLASIUS.' The bottom right image illustrates a haloed figure praying near a book underneath a tree, marked 'S. ISIDOR MONACH.' Each scene is intricately detailed, with fine ink work emphasized by hatching and line work, characteristic of historical religious illustrations.

artworks.title: St. Agatha; St. Dorothy; St. Romuald of Ravenna; St. Paul, Bishop of Verdun
artworks.description: The image is divided into four separate oval sections, each containing a different religious figure. The top left section depicts two figures in front of a cityscape. The top right section shows another pair against a city background. The bottom left section displays a figure near a tree with a church visible. The bottom right section shows a bearded monk with a staff in a natural setting.

artworks.title: St. Apollonia; St. Guillaume; St. Scholastica; St. Saturnin
artworks.description: There are four oval frames in the image, each depicting a full-body figure. In the top left oval, there is a woman standing next to a man with tied hands, a calm expression, and flowing hair with a halo. They are dressed in robes and stand near a column. The top right oval shows an older man with a long beard, wearing a halo and a tunic-like garment. He is standing with one hand raised. The bottom left oval shows a woman with pleated robes and a halo, with a neutral expression, standing in front of two buildings. In the bottom right oval, a man is wearing a robe and a unique hat, holding an open book. He also has a halo. The buildings in the background give architectural context to each portrait, and the scenes are likely religious in nature.

artworks.title: St. Eulalia; St. Fusca and Maura; St. Valentine; St. Anthony
artworks.description: This is a drawing of religious depictions related to various saints and martyrs in medallion-style frames. There are four separate illustrations framed in oval shapes on pages showing scenes from the lives of different saints. Each image includes a date in February with the name of the saint(s) depicted. The top left shows a crucifixion scene with Saint Eulalia on a cross alongside Roman soldiers. The top right depicts Saints Fusca and her nurse Maura interacting with soldiers. The bottom left shows the martyrdom of Saint Valentine with soldiers. The bottom right shows Saint Antonine in a contemplative pose with animals around him, possibly representing peace or meditation. Each scene is detailed with attention to costumes and backgrounds, presenting historical-religious scenes.

artworks.title: Sts. Faustinus and Jovita; St. Juliana; St. Onesimus; St. Policronius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four illustrations depicting scenes with figures in classical or biblical attire, each within an oval frame. The top left scene shows a figure with wings bending towards a person in the water. The top right image shows a figure kneeling before others on a high seat. The bottom left shows several figures interacting, set against a cityscape. The bottom right portrays a figure with a nimbus over its head being led by others in a setting with clouds above and a light beam illuminating the central figure.

artworks.title: St. Simeon; St. Gabinius; St. Eucharius; St. Silvanus
St. Felix; St. Joseph of Arimathea; St. Polycarpe; St. Matthias, Apostle
artworks.description: The image consists of four panels, each depicting a different figure in different settings. In the top left corner, a seated man with a long beard and a bishop's mitre on his head interacts with a kneeling figure next to him; both wear long robes. Behind them, another person dressed similarly stands in an indoor setting with arched windows. The top right panel features a standing man with a long beard, wrapped in a flowing garment and turban, set against an outdoor background showing distant architectural elements and barren earth. In the bottom left panel, two figures are present; one figure is shown from behind with a bald head and in a tunic, apparently being led by another figure against a background suggesting a landscape or battlefield. The bottom right panel presents a robed man with a halo, holding a tool shaped like an axe and another unspecified object, standing amidst rolling hills and groups of smaller figures. Each panel is labeled with names and dates at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: St. Nicephorus; St. Nestor; St. Julian; Translation of St. Augustin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious-themed scenes, each enclosed within an oval frame with a date in February. The first panel shows three figures around a barrel. The second scene features a figure on a table with another figure behind them. The third panel shows a figure riding a camel near buildings. The final scene depicts clerical figures around a table with a cloth adorned with a cross.

artworks.title: The Guardian Angel; St. Simplici; St. Cunegundes; St. Luci
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious and mythological scenes. The top left scene features a guardian angel protecting a small child in a pastoral landscape. The top right scene shows a saintly figure dressed in papal robes, holding a book, with an architectural background that includes domed buildings. In the bottom left, a crowned and praying female figure stands upon a landscape. The bottom right shows a figure being attacked by a horned creature while wearing a halo, with a cityscape in the background. Each scene is contained within its own oval frame. The figures and landscapes are detailed through careful line work and stippling, while the composition and design suggest a period style associated with early modern religious iconography.

artworks.title: St. Phocas; St. Theophilus; St. Conon; Sts. Perpetua and Felicitas
artworks.description: The image contains four oval frames, each depicting a different religious saint or event with inscriptions above. The first scene shows a church with a figure kneeling before it, labeled "S. Phocas MAR." The upper right scene shows a figure in religious robes gazing up at the sky, with clouds above and the inscription "S. THEOPHI EPVS." The lower left scene illustrates a person driving a horse-drawn chariot towards a building under the inscription "S. CONON MAR." The lower right scene depicts a figure kneeling next to a ladder against a wall, with rays of light shining down, labeled "SS. PERPET VA ET FOELIC M." Each scene features detailed line work and is signed "Israel ex."

artworks.title: St. Thomas Aquin; St. Adrian and Companions; St. Frances; St. Macari
artworks.description:
The image depicts four separate illustrations within a grid, each showing different figures associated with saintly imagery. 

Top left: A kneeling man with a halo, labeled S. Thomas Aquinas, is shown from the side. He has short hair, a robe, and is next to an altar with an open book, a crucifix, and a church in the background.

Top right: Labeled S. Adrian et Sotii, a group of men on a cliff pushing another man over. The figures are shown from the side in robes, with clouds and water below.

Bottom left: A figure labeled S. Francisca Vidva standing with a halo, holding a book. A small angel stands beside her. The person has covered hair and wears a robe, with a building in the background.

Bottom right: A man labeled S. Macari Epis standing in profile, wearing a robe and a bishop's hat while carrying a crozier. The background shows a landscape with other figures and buildings.

artworks.title: St. Meliton; St. Firminus; St. Gregory the Great; St. Euphrasia
artworks.description: Four illustrations featuring different religious figures or scenes within oval frames. The top-left illustration shows two figures with halos walking alongside a cart on a hilly path. The top-right illustration portrays a figure wearing a robe and a halo, holding a staff and a book in front of a small church. The bottom-left illustration shows robed figures looking up towards a heavenly scene with rays emanating from a dove. The bottom-right image depicts a figure with a halo kneeling with hands raised, facing a rocky landscape with a small dog nearby. The illustrations have a consistent stylistic approach with hatching for shading and detail.

artworks.title: St. Matilda; St. Longinus; St. Cyriacus; St. Heribert
artworks.description: Four oval illustrations are arranged in a two-by-two grid. The first is labeled 'S. Mathild REGINA,' showing a figure with a crown, under dramatic rays of light. The second is labeled 'S. Longinus MILES M.,' showing a figure kneeling with a raised spear. The third is labeled 'SS. Cyriacus et Smaragds M.,' showing two figures interacting. The last is labeled 'S. Heribert EP. Colon,' showing a figure in religious attire holding a staff, with an architectural structure in the background.

artworks.title: St. Patrick; St. Gertrude; St. Gabriel, Archangel; St. Edward
artworks.description:
The image shows four oval illustrations, each representing a figure associated with a specific day in March and labeled with the names of religious or historical figures.

In the top-left illustration, a figure assumed to be St. Patrick is depicted in profile, pointing towards a cave with emerging snakes. He wears a long robe and a wide-brimmed hat, set against a background of rocky formations and buildings.

In the top-right illustration, St. Gertrude kneels with a cross in hand, surrounded by rays of light and natural elements in a meadow or open field.

The bottom-left illustration features the Archangel Gabriel flying with spread wings, against a backdrop of clouds and light rays.

In the bottom-right illustration, St. Edward is shown on horseback, gesturing towards a building with a sword-wielding attendant beside him and medieval architectural elements in the background.
